v00-family.observed_description: A family of six stands on the front lawn of their two-story house, smiling, left to right: a grandfather with white hair, glasses and a navy cardigan; a grandmother with grey curly hair and a red cardigan; a father with short black hair in a light-blue shirt; a mother with long straight brown hair in a green blouse; a girl with two long dark braids in a yellow T-shirt; a boy with short brown hair in an orange T-shirt; a black-and-white dog sits in front.
v00-family.note: Usable as the review family's reference only (not shown in the lesson): six clearly different people and the dog; the father is clean-shaven rather than bearded, and later photos keep him so.

v01-grandfather-upstairs.observed_description: Seen from the downstairs hallway, a straight wooden staircase rises to a white landing; the review family's grandfather (white hair, navy cardigan, beige trousers) stands upstairs on the landing with a hand on the banister; the stairs and hallway are empty.
v01-grandfather-upstairs.note: Usable: upstairs is obvious and he stays inside the centered 4:5 crop; he is small but reads at 360 px.

v02-girl-lamp-on.observed_description: In the evening the review family's girl (two long dark braids, yellow T-shirt) sits at a white desk with an open notebook, one hand at the base switch of a white desk lamp that glows brightly and lights the page.
v02-girl-lamp-on.note: Usable: the lamp is on and it is the only lamp lit in the review photos.

v03-dog-behind-chair.observed_description: In a bright living room a mustard-yellow armchair stands in the middle; the review family's black-and-white dog peeks over its back, only its head and front paws showing; nothing on the seat or the floor in front.
v03-dog-behind-chair.note: Usable: behind the chair is obvious; no people.

v04-children-garden.observed_description: The review family's girl (braids, yellow T-shirt) and boy (orange T-shirt) sit side by side on the grass of the garden in front of their house, each reading an open book; no ball or toys.
v04-children-garden.note: Usable: two children in the garden; no football, so She plays football never fits it.

v05-mother-teeth.observed_description: In a bright white bathroom the review family's mother (long straight brown hair, green blouse) brushes her teeth with a blue toothbrush at the sink; her face is dry and the tap is off.
v05-mother-teeth.note: Usable: brushing teeth, not washing her face.

v06-father-cleans.observed_description: In a bright kitchen the review family's father (short black hair, light-blue shirt, sleeves rolled up) wipes an empty light wooden table with a yellow cloth, a spray bottle in his other hand.
v06-father-cleans.note: Usable: cleaning the table; the table is empty, so no cups sentence fits it.

v07-boy-washes-car.observed_description: The review family's boy (orange T-shirt) washes a blue car with a yellow sponge in front of the house; soap foam runs down the car door and a red bucket of soapy water stands by his feet; no number plate shows.
v07-boy-washes-car.note: Usable: washing the car is obvious; no number anywhere.

v08-boy-gives-cup.observed_description: In the living room the review family's grandmother (grey curly hair, red cardigan) sits in an armchair and takes ONE white cup from the boy (orange T-shirt), who gives it to her with both hands.
v08-boy-gives-cup.note: Usable: one cup, so it and not them; no table with cups.

v09-girl-football.observed_description: The review family's girl (braids, yellow T-shirt, black leggings) kicks a black-and-white football on a green park field; nobody else.
v09-girl-football.note: Usable: playing football; she is small but central and reads at 360 px.

v10-grandmother-birthday.observed_description: The review family's grandmother (grey curly hair, red cardigan) sits alone at a wooden table in a kraft party hat and smiles at a chocolate cake with six lit thin candles; red, yellow and blue balloons behind her.
v10-grandmother-birthday.note: Usable: her birthday; no number or letter anywhere.

v11-cups-some.observed_description: A bright kitchen with nobody in it: four white cups of coffee stand together on a round white table; nothing else is on the table.
v11-cups-some.note: Usable: some cups on the table.
